result.text:
---
title: 'Messi' 'Messi!' 'Messi!' Messi's match-winning free-kick: Moment of the Weekend
author: Anirudh Menon
date: 2023-02-20
---
Non-stop action. Great goals. Controversies galore. Sensational passes. Unreal drama. European football rarely lacks for talking points after any given weekend of football, but with so much happening it can often be hard to focus on the biggest moments. ESPN India attempts to single out one moment from all the action across Europe's top 5 leagues (league action only) that lit up the weekend.

This weekend, we pick Lionel Messi's last-gasp free-kick that led Paris Saint Germain to a 4-3 win over Lille.

'Messi' 'Messi!' 'Messi!'

Lionel Messi picked up the ball, held it in his hands for a moment and then gave it a little spin. It was the 95th minute of PSG's home game vs Lille and he had seen very little of the round thing. That spin felt like it was done almost to reassure the ball that it was back at his feet now. The score read 3-3.

'Messi' 'Messi!' 'Messi!'

It had been the Kylian Mbappe show for PSG till then. He had opened the scoring with a goal that evoked memories of prime ('96-'99) Ronaldo: bullying two defenders as he pushed past them like they were sliding doors (while nutmegging one of them) and slotting home under pressure from a third. He had equalised to make 3-3 with a sliding finish that looked like it had been lifted from a particularly outlandish anime.

result.title: Last-minute goal - Wikipedia
result.text:
*2022 FIFA World Cup qualification – UEFA second round – Italy vs. North Macedonia, 24 March 2022: Italy had controlled the match, creating multiple chances but struggling to convert them. With the game seemingly going to extra time, in the 90+2 minute(90'+1:45), Aleksandar Trajkovski scored from outside the box, which eliminated Italy from the 2022 FIFA World Cup despite having won the 2020 UEFA Euro months earlier.
*2024 UEFA European Championship – Round of 16 – England vs. Slovakia, 30 June 2024: After conceding a goal in the 25th minute against Slovakia, and a disallowed goal in the 49th minute by Phil Foden, during the 90+5th minute in the second half, Jude Bellingham scored, equalising the game and continuing the game into extra time. In the 91st minute during extra time, just under 2 minutes after the first goal Harry Kane scored, and maintained the 2–1 lead throughout the match, knocking out Slovakia from the knockout stages.

*2027 AFC Asian Cup qualification Third round - Hong Kong vs. India, 10 June 2025: A 95th minute penalty from Stefan Pereira was the only goal of the game, giving Hong Kong victory in its first ever game played at their new home, the Kai Tak Stadium.

Based on the search results, there is no document in the supplied corpus that identifies a player taking a free kick specifically in the **95th minute of a football final**.

The documents found mention players scoring free kicks in the 95th minute, but these were during regular league matches, not finals:
*   **Lionel Messi** scored a match-winning free kick in the 95th minute for PSG against Lille in a Ligue 1 league game (Document `17992`, URL: https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/35699773/messi-free-kick-psg-vs-lille-ligue-1-football-moment-weekend).
*   **Léo Scienza** curled in a free kick for Heidenheim in stoppage time (the 95th minute) in a league match (Document `44465`, URL: https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/43428776).

While "last-minute goals" and specific instances like the 95th-minute penalty by Stefan Pereira are listed in a Wikipedia article on last-minute goals (Document `40496`), none of the provided texts describe a **final** where a free kick was taken in the 95th minute. Therefore, the document does not establish such an event.
